title: Her first interview
summary: The local paper sends its newest reporter, twenty-two, for her first ever interview, and it's you. Her hands are shaking and her recorder isn't on. A season on, she's been promoted, or she hasn't.

ends.title: Her first
ends.text: You were a young reporter's first ever interview and you told her the recorder wasn't on. She covers the club now. She always gets the first question.

ends.title: The press line
ends.text: You gave a young reporter her first interview, in press office lines. She writes about someone else's club now.

beats.title: The recorder

event.title: The recorder
event.speaker: reporter
setup: The {reporter.outlet} has sent its newest reporter for her first ever interview. {reporter.name}, twenty-two. Her hands are shaking. Her recorder's on the table. The red light isn't on.

say: She's asked four questions. They were good questions. She's writing nothing down, because she thinks the recorder's doing it.

replies.label: Slow down, and repeat the good answers.
Give her the press office lines.

tell.text: She goes bright red, presses it, and asks if you'd mind going back to question one. You go back to question one. You give better answers the second time.

slow.text: You say the good bits again, slowly, at the end, "in case." She looks at the recorder, and goes red, and writes them down.

press.text: She gets her piece. It's three hundred words of the gaffer believing in you. It's on page thirty.

beats.hint: A new reporter wants an interview

beats.title: The first question

event.title: The first question
event.speaker: reporter
setup: A season on, the press room after a game. {reporter.short} is in the front row with a lanyard that says CHIEF FOOTBALL WRITER. Her recorder's red light is on. She checks it twice.

choices.label: Point at her for the first question.

outcomes.text: "Is it on?" you ask. The whole room laughs. She's the only one who knows why.
She asks a sharp question. You give her a press office line. She writes it down without looking up.
She doesn't get one in. She waits for you by the door instead and asks it there, recorder on.
She doesn't get one in. She covers a different club by the summer.
